submission.justification: Absorber-F3 gave the best resolution in every simulation. I scanned F3 at 2, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 7 and 10 mm, and 4 mm was best at 3.17%. The 2025 summary at 5 mm and my F1 and F2 runs at 2 and 3.5 mm put F1 and F2 behind F3. The hands-on maintenance constraint could not be verified. No document says anything about activation or radiation levels for any candidate. Please check F3's activation and dose with the safety or radiation-protection team before committing.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F3 at 4 mm gave 3.17%. F3 at 3.5 mm gave 3.23% and at 4.5 mm 3.25%. F1 gave 4.25% at 3.5 mm and F2 gave 5.5% at 2 mm. The 2025 5 mm results were F3 3.2%, F1 3.9% and F2 5.1%. I did not run F1 or F2 over the full thickness range, and 4 mm is the best of the F3 thicknesses I tried, not a fine-grained optimum.

requirements.requirement: Absorber is one of the three listed materials

requirements.evidence: No document covers activation, residual dose or radiation levels. The mechanical support is compatible with all candidates, but that does not address activation. This needs checking.
